idle: Nice night for a harbor stroll, huh?
Smells like crab shells and money.
Guard the pavilion. Guard it hard.
Who left fries on the bricks? Mine.
Tails up, boys. Keep it tight.
Quiet tonight. Too quiet, hon.
Mustard jacket, navy heart. Rat life.
I heard a cane tapping. You hear that?
taunt: Hey grandpa, you lost your lily pad?
Hop on home, old timer!
That cane ain't scaring nobody, yo.
North shore's ours. Beat it!
You move slower than harbor traffic.
Ribbit all you want, you're done.
Mavis, hon, your man is in trouble.
We got cheese and numbers. You got a stick.
hit: Hey, that cane is a weapon!
Oof, right in the snack pouch.
That's assault with a walking aid!
Ow! I felt that in my ancestors!
ko: Tell my cheese I loved it...
I'm just gonna lie here a while.
Beat by a senior citizen. Great.
Somebody call the sewer, I'm out.
Okay. Okay. You win this block.

idle: Mine. Mine. Also mine.
Got my eye on that soft pretzel.
Pier's breezy tonight. Perfect.
Who's got fries? Anybody? Fries?
Circle the pier, then circle again.
White and blue, flock on through.
Aquarium crowd drops the best snacks.
Keep your beaks sharp, flock.
taunt: Squawk off, swamp boy!
Old toad, new tricks? Nah.
We fly. You hop. Do the math.
I'll steal your cane AND your lunch.
This pier is gull country, hon!
Flock up! Grandpa wants a fight!
You'd make a great snack, bud.
Watch the sky, slowpoke!
ko: I see... a big... french fry...
Tell the flock... I flew good.
Down for the count. Down for good.

idle: Cobblestones keep my fins cool.
Slow water, slow talk, slow night.
Whiskers twitching. Somebody's near.
Fells Point fog is my blanket.
Teal and slate, we never wait.
Mmm. Mud. Like home.
Bottom feeder? I prefer "curator."
Just vibing by the old pier, hon.
taunt: You smell like pond scum, pal.
These stones are ours, old toad.
I'll whisker-slap you to Pigtown.
Come on down the cobbles, frog.
We're slippery. You're slow.
Bet you can't even swim, gramps.
Catfish don't bite. We wallop.
Hey Harold! Your cane's crooked!
hit: Oof, you hit like a crab trap!
ko: Back to the mud I go...

idle: Mask on. Always mask on.
Trash cans by the stadium? Jackpot.
Orange and grey, we rule the west.
Shh. Footsteps on the concourse.
Nice night for a little light theft.
Got a hot dog. Found it. Mostly.
Lookout duty is so boring, B.
Anybody seen my other glove?
taunt: Nice handbag, Mavis. Mine now.
I'll lift your wallet AND your cane.
West side bandits, baby!
You can't stop what you can't see.
Little froggy wants to play?
We got the masks, you got the wrinkles.
Grab him! He's slow!
Ooh, a toad. Haven't robbed one yet.
hit: Ow! I just stole this jacket!
ko: I'll be in the dumpster. Resting.
Tell Ma I almost got away.
You got me. Don't tell the crew.
Down like a trash can lid.

idle: Floatin' on my back. Living right.
South shore breeze hits different.
Anybody got a clam? I got a rock.
Fort's quiet. Fed Hill's quieter.
Green and brown, we hold this town.
Holding paws so we don't drift.
Just juggling pebbles, hon.
Smell that sugar? Love this shore.
taunt: Splish splash, you're trash, gramps!
Otters roll deep. Toads roll home.
Key Highway's ours. Turn around!
Come swim with us. Oh wait.
We play rough. Real rough.
Your cane's my new back scratcher.
Little toad, big mistake.
Down the ocean? Down the drain!
hit: That's no way to treat a cutie!
Not the fur! It took hours!
Ow, my rock! You made me drop it!
ko: I just wanted to be cute...
Belly up and out of luck.

intro: Batter up, Harold! Heads up too!
Welcome to my hallway. It's a long way to first.
Nobody hits my heater, old timer!
defeat: My arm! I'm going on the injured list!
Fine. You can have the brick hallway.

intro: Nevermore will you cross my field!
Hut! Hut! Hike up those pants, toad!
Shoulder pads on. Mercy off.
defeat: I got sacked by a senior...
Flag on the play. Me. I'm the flag.

intro: Welcome to my lab! The screen is HUGE!
My experiments need a test toad!
Goggles down! Science is about to hurt!
defeat: Back in my shell... for science...
Note to self: never fight a toad.

intro: Hey hon! Come up the hill, hon!
This beehive's got a sting, sweetie.
Hairspray! Extra hold! Down you go!
defeat: Okay hon, you win. Go get a crab cake.
Not the capris! Not the capris!

intro: I'm sweet, but I hit like a truck!
Glitter and grit, toad! Taste it!
Neon on, sugar high, you're done!
defeat: Somebody sweep me up. I'm crumbs.

intro: Feel the squeeze, old man!
No logo, no mercy!
My gear is tight. My grip is tighter.
Fire the rockets! For the crown!
1812 called. I'm still mad about it.
This fort will fall, little toad!
Welcome to my tank, shrimp.
Big Jimmy don't do steamed, hon.
Claws out, toad. Down in the deep.
defeat: Ack... I'm in hot water now...

intro: Drop the beat! Drop the toad!
Charm City club, high voltage!
Hands up! Gonna shock 'em all!
defeat: No more juice. No more jams.

intro: Order up! One toad, well done!
Taste my seasoning! In your eyes!
Two mallets, one Harold. Let's cook!
defeat: Too much seasoning... even for me...
Fine. You get the chef's special.

intro: Get outta my lane, toad!
Fresh produce, fast horse, no brakes!
Yo! Arabber coming through!
defeat: You win. Have a peach, old timer.

intro: Wanna play? Winner takes the cabana.
Rack 'em up, grandpa!
Eight ball, side pocket: you.
Kneel before the Duchess of the harbor!
My paddle-sceptre says you're done!
Row, row, row your toad... under!
defeat: My tiara! It's in the harbor!

intro: Yarr! This ship be haunted, toad!
My lantern lights the way to your doom!
Ghosts don't feel canes, matey!
defeat: Back to the fog... I go...

intro: Welcome to the top, peasant toad.
Drink? No? Then fight.
Up here, I rule the skyline.
defeat: I'm... coming down in the world...
Pigeon down. On the penthouse deck.

intro: Get off my clean steps, hon!
These marble steps shine. You won't!
Suds up! Slip and slide, toad!
defeat: I'll scrub this loss away tomorrow.
Okay hon, you can sit on the stoop.

intro: Welcome to my city, Harold.
Nothing cracks Formstone, old toad.
Every block in B-more answers to me.
defeat: You see me now... the real me...
The city's yours... for now, toad.

bumpers.text: AUTO mode, hon. We follow the sun and the moon for you.
B-MORE 410 DAY, sun's up over the harbor. Stay hydrated, hon.
B-MORE 410 NIGHT, lights low, harbor glowing. Watch your back.
DUCKY DYNAMO FM! Quack it loud, Charm City!
LOR BITEWHO on your dial. Smooth bites, all night long.
B-MORE CLUB, feet moving, harbor shaking. Don't stop now!
B-MORE RAP, straight from the 410. Turn it up, yo.
Late night in B-more, rats out and gulls up. Keep it tuned here.
Traffic on Pratt? Grab a crab cake and ride it out with us.
Club beat check! If your cane is tapping, you're doing it right.

harborplace.name: HARBORPLACE
blurb: Waterfront shopping pavilions on the Inner Harbor, opened in 1980.
The Dragon Boat Duchess paddles here like she owns the place.

constellation.name: USS CONSTELLATION
blurb: A Navy sail warship built in 1854, now a museum at the harbor.
Captain Cobblestone haunts the deck with a lantern at night.

wtc.name: WORLD TRADE CENTER
blurb: A five-sided office tower on the harbor with a view up top.
The Penthouse Pigeon sips tea on the roof and looks down on all.

aquarium.name: NATIONAL AQUARIUM
blurb: A big aquarium on the Inner Harbor piers, opened in 1981.
Big Jimmy runs the tanks and refuses to be steamed.

powerplant.name: POWER PLANT
blurb: An old brick power plant on Pier 4, now shops and restaurants.
Voltage Vic still keeps the place charged with club beats.

fourseasons.name: FOUR SEASONS
blurb: A tall hotel in Harbor East, right by the water.
Chef Crabcake runs the kitchen and seasons guests on sight.

pendry.name: PENDRY
blurb: A hotel in the old Recreation Pier building at Fells Point.
The Pool Shark hustles poolside in a loud cabana shirt.

fells.name: FELLS POINT
blurb: A historic waterfront neighborhood with cobblestone streets.
Arabber Al races his horse-cart over the bricks, no brakes.

monument.name: WASHINGTON MONUMENT
blurb: A tall marble column in Mount Vernon, begun in 1815.
The Stoop Scrubber keeps every nearby marble step spotless.

orioles.name: ORIOLE PARK
blurb: A downtown ballpark opened in 1992 beside a long brick warehouse.
Bird Brain Bobby throws fastballs down the warehouse hallway.

ravens.name: M&T BANK STADIUM
blurb: A pro football stadium beside the ballpark, opened in 1998.
The Raven King blitzes anyone who steps onto his field.

science.name: SCIENCE CENTER
blurb: A hands-on science museum on the harbor with an IMAX theater.
Mad turtle Shellacious runs wild experiments on the big screen.

fedhill.name: FEDERAL HILL
blurb: A hilltop park with a great view over the Inner Harbor.
The Hon Queen guards the top and shoves you down the hill.

domino.name: DOMINO SUGARS
blurb: A sugar refinery on the harbor with a giant neon roof sign.
Sugar Rush glitters under the sign, sweet but mean.

underarmour.name: UNDER ARMOUR
blurb: A company campus at Tide Point on the south shore.
The Compression King lurks here in blank, unbranded gear.

fort.name: FORT MCHENRY
blurb: A star-shaped fort whose 1814 defense inspired the anthem.
Admiral Redclaw still wants a rematch, rockets and all.
